dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: Oh, I didn't mean anything by it. Actually, this place isn't half bad.

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: The guards here are pretty friendly. And as long as you work, you get Credit Coupons. Heck, they even feed you on a daily basis. If nothing else, it's certainly more stable than being a mercenary.
